name: PHP Profiler
description: Profiles Drupal with XHProf and uploads results to XHGui (via perftools/php-profiler). DEVELOPMENT/DIAGNOSTIC tool that captures detailed runtime data (call graphs, args, timings) and sends it to XHGui — never enable in production, and keep the XHGui destination trusted/private.
project_description:
Provides a XHProf storage backend option to use XHGui to store profiling data using the XHProf module .

 Installation / Configuration 
 Enable the module and its dependencies. Go to the XHProf config form and select "XHGui Upload" as the storage option. Then set the base URL for your XHGui instance (do not include the /run/import path as it is added automatically).

 For running XHGuid you can use the official Docker container https://hub.docker.com/r/xhgui/xhgui or configure your own instance.

 For an example containerized local development setup, see the Dropfort Build Docker compose file .
